credit_metrics.text: EBITDA increased by {{ebitda.change@FY2025}} to {{ebitda@FY2025}}, lifting the EBITDA margin by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2025}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2025}}.

Total debt rose by {{total_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{total_debt@FY2025}} and net debt by {{net_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{net_debt@FY2025}}, yet gross leverage fell by {{gross_leverage.change@FY2025}} to {{gross_leverage@FY2025}} as EBITDA rose by {{ebitda.change@FY2025}}.
Interest coverage improved by {{interest_coverage.change@FY2025}} to {{interest_coverage@FY2025}}, in line with the peer median.
FFO rose by {{ffo.change@FY2025}} to {{ffo@FY2025}}, taking FFO to debt up by {{ffo_to_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{ffo_to_debt@FY2025}}.
Free cash flow turned positive at {{fcf@FY2025}}, taking FCF to debt up by {{fcf_to_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf_to_debt@FY2025}}, still below the peer median of {{fcf_to_debt.peer_median@2025}}.

liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments were stable at {{cash_like@FY2025}}, a change of {{cash_like.change@FY2025}} on the prior year.

Cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}}, below the peer median of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_median@2025}}, so the buffer is thinner relative to the revenue base.

Advance ticket cover rose by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2025}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2025}}, with contract liabilities up {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2025}} to {{contract_liabilities@FY2025}}, so a growing part of the cash balance is customer prepayment.

operating_performance.text: Revenue grew by {{revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{revenue@FY2025}}, with operating profit up {{operating_profit.change@FY2025}} to {{operating_profit@FY2025}}.

Capex intensity rose by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2025}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2025}}, above the peer median of {{capex_intensity.peer_median@2025}}, as the fleet renewal programme absorbs a larger share of revenue.
The last reported fleet stood at {{fleet@FY2024}} aircraft with an average age of {{fleet_age@FY2024}}.

peer_positioning.text: Air France-KLM sits at the peer median on EBITDA margin ({{ebitda_margin@FY2025}} against {{ebitda_margin.peer_median@2025}}), net leverage ({{net_leverage@FY2025}} against {{net_leverage.peer_median@2025}}) and FFO to debt ({{ffo_to_debt@FY2025}} against {{ffo_to_debt.peer_median@2025}}), ranking {{net_leverage.peer_rank@2025}} on leverage.
FCF to debt of {{fcf_to_debt@FY2025}} is below the peer median of {{fcf_to_debt.peer_median@2025}}, the weakest of the group ({{fcf_to_debt.peer_rank@2025}}).
Cash liquidity to revenue of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}} is below the peer median of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_median@2025}} and ranks {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_rank@2025}}.

Advance ticket cover of {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2025}} is below the peer median of {{advance_ticket_cover.peer_median@2025}} yet ranks {{advance_ticket_cover.peer_rank@2025}}, the highest in the group.

watch_items.text: Cash generation: FCF to debt of {{fcf_to_debt@FY2025}} remains below the peer median of {{fcf_to_debt.peer_median@2025}} despite the improvement of {{fcf_to_debt.change@FY2025}}, so the conversion of EBITDA into cash is the metric to track.

Investment: capex intensity rose by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2025}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2025}}, above the peer median of {{capex_intensity.peer_median@2025}}, which limits free cash flow while the fleet is renewed.

Liquidity: cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}}, the weakest of the network peers ({{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_rank@2025}}), while total debt rose by {{total_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{total_debt@FY2025}}.

Customer prepayments: advance ticket cover rose by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2025}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2025}}, with contract liabilities of {{contract_liabilities@FY2025}}, a refund exposure if bookings slow.
